scripts.dev: npm run -w=shared-code build && concurrently --names "SHARED,FRONT,BACK" --prefix-colors "auto" --timestamped false "npm run -w=shared-code dev" "npm run -w=front-end dev" "npm run -w=back-end dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w=shared-code build && concurrently --names "FRONT,BACK" --prefix-colors "auto" --timestamped false "npm run -w=front-end build" "npm run -w=back-end build"
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run -w=back-end start
scripts.test: npm run -w=shared-code build && npm run -w=shared-code test && npm run -w=front-end test && npm run -w=back-end test
